post_result_lemmas.name: FINITE_MIXED_PARTIAL_MESSAGE_COMPOSITION
post_result_lemmas.statement: On all 72 frozen constructed cases, neither whole component was accepted by a single projector, yet two or three partial exact languages were discovered and their replayable messages joined to exact compact component messages and an exact UNSAT cross-component join with zero solver-side boundary assignment enumeration.

post_result_lemmas.name: LINEAR_MESSAGE_AND_LEDGER_PROFILE_ON_V4_FAMILIES
post_result_lemmas.statement: Across the frozen k ladder, combined component message atoms were exactly 2k and measured DAG/join/serialization ledgers grew approximately linearly rather than as 2^k. This is an empirical property of the constructed v4 families, not a worst-case theorem.

post_result_lemmas.name: CLEAN_INTERNAL_FACTORIZATION_IS_THE_NEXT_ASSUMPTION
post_result_lemmas.statement: The v4 projector composition is enabled by an exact decomposition into modules whose internal variables are disjoint once the supplied boundary is removed. The next adversarial gate must destroy this clean factorization by sharing internal variables across language fragments.

scientific_boundary.what_was_shown: Finite exact composition of multiple partial symbolic boundary languages on wide supplied boundaries, with no whole-language shortcut and no solver-side 2^k enumeration, while measured message/DAG/join/serialization costs remained compact on the frozen structured families.
what_was_not_shown: No theorem for entangled language fragments sharing internal variables.

next_frontier: ENTANGLED_PARTIAL_BOUNDARY_COMPOSITION: share internal variables between GF2/Horn/2SAT fragments so internal-component decomposition no longer separates languages; require exact projection/join without 2^k fallback or hidden exponential DAG/serialization/discovery.
